_comment: Season data for database/seed.js. Fall 2026: the eight teams below are the
real ones. Run: npm run seed  (add --reset to clear the previous season).
Slugs are set explicitly rather than derived from the name, because the
names slugify into unusable URLs ("S.C Cairo" -> "s-c-cairo"). The slug
chosen is the same prefix the design files use, so one identifier ties the
team row, /teams/<slug>, the crest, and the kit artwork together.
Colours are each kit's dominant colour, with one exception: cscp is the
deeper #4F8A8A rather than the pale #a1cbcc its crest is drawn in. Nothing
renders primaryColor yet, but the pale teal is 1.76:1 on white -- unusable
the moment anything does -- so the stored value is a strength of the same
hue that would actually work as an accent.
sponsorName/sponsorLogoUrl are omitted for teams whose sponsorship has not
been sold yet -- the team page just leaves the block out. Add them here and
re-run the seed when a sponsor signs.
teams[].players accepts either a plain name (jersey number left as TBD) or
an object: { "name": "...", "jerseyNumber": 7, "position": "Forward" }.
Jersey numbers must be unique within a team; omit the field for TBD.
Rosters are empty here because the league drafts on 30 August 2026 -- the
picks land through the live draft board, not through this file.
games[] is optional -- fixtures can also be added from the admin UI.
A playoff game sets "playoffRound" to one of: play-in, quarterfinal,
semifinal, final, and may leave homeTeam/awayTeam out for an unfilled slot.
